purpose: native charging dwell in the transit schedule (issue #74)
rule: departureOffset = arrivalOffset + max(existing gap, A.lightrail.dwell_charging_s) at INTERMEDIATE intervention-mode stops; arrival offsets untouched, so end-to-end scheduled run time is unchanged by construction
concurrency: CONCURRENT with boarding: dwell = max(board, charge) - charge-at-stop happens during passenger exchange, so plain offsets suffice and boarding time is not double-counted (decision, DECISIONS.md 9.76)
derivation: from each scenario's own already-mapped schedule; the mapper is never re-run (DECISIONS.md 3.5)
activation: INERT until the batched family boundary re-derives the run-input sets from transitSchedule_dwell.xml.gz
